title: Cheyenne Depot Museum

services.name: Lobby Rentals
services.desc: The Lobby is available for graduation parties, birthdays, or other special events. Email us at cdmrentals@cheyennedepotmuseum.org for rental pricing, details, and availability. The lobby is available for full and half day rentals. There are decorating restrictions because of the historic nature of the building. These are detailed in the Cheyenne Depot Museum Rental

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The Cheyenne Depot Museum is the steward of the Historic UPRR Depot, a National Historic Landmark. Built in 1886 by the Union Pacific Railroad, it is the last remaining grand railroad station on the transcontinental route, designed by famed architect Henry Van Brunt.
